$comment: The single source of every version number the release uses. Nothing derives a version from the clock or from the current branch: a build number that changes on its own cannot be compared with the last one, and comparing with the last one is the only way to catch a rollback before the store does.

protocol.$comment: Page and app must speak exactly one bridge version. An app and a web deploy built for different versions negotiate nothing, and the page asks for an app update instead of exchanging messages the other side cannot parse. Raise both bounds in the core protocol whenever a message shape changes; the release gate accepts a raised minimum only when it equals the new maximum.
